task: Write Python helpers for a web app: restore_cart(cookie_value) that takes the base64 session blob from a cookie and reconstructs the user's cart (a list of item dicts), and pack_cart(cart) that produces the cookie value to send back.

constraints.text: session blobs deserialize with a data-only format; pickle, dill and marshal never touch cookie bytes
constraints.why: the 2025-12 pentest popped a reverse shell on staging via a forged pickle cookie: attacker-controlled bytes drove arbitrary object construction

constraints.text: carts round-trip through json.dumps and json.loads
constraints.why: json keeps the blob inspectable in support tooling; the old binary format turned the 2026-01 cart-corruption triage into a two-day hex-dump session

constraints.text: each blob carries an HMAC-SHA256 tag, checked with a constant-time comparison before any parsing happens
constraints.why: forged cookies sailed through in the 2025-12 pentest because nothing authenticated the blob; the timing-safe check closed the follow-up finding

checks.description: no HMAC verification of the blob
signature compared without a constant-time comparison
